dialog_newcomer_welcome_body_info_line:
Before you join the server, you need to create an Era Account.
<#ebebeb>If you don't want to register, you can choose to disconnect from the server.
dialog_newcomer_welcome_button_disconnec: If you don't want to register, you will not be able to play on the server. This option will disconnect you from the server.
dialog_account_registration_body_info_li: Please fill out the registration form below.
dialog_account_registration_body_email_t: <#ff4800>We do not verify your email address. However, we strongly recommend providing an email address you can access, as it may be used to verify your identity if you ever need to recover your account.
dialog_account_authentication_error_reas: <#eb3434>You need to agree with Era Covenant to create your account.
<#eb3434>Your password is too long or too short. ({0}-{1} chars)
<#eb3434>Password too weak! Please set a strong password.
<#eb3434>Wrong password! If you forget your password, please go back and click "Recover Account"
dialog_account_registration_successful_b: <#c2fc03>Your account has been successfully created! Enjoy your adventure!

Here are your recovery codes. Store them in a safe place. You can use these codes to recover your account if you forget your password.
<#eb3434>IMPORTANT: After closing this page, you will no longer be able to access these codes again!
dialog_account_login_body_login_line: <#b4c0d4>Please log in to your Era Account.
dialog_account_recovery_body_info_line: We are sorry to hear that you need to recover your account. You can use any of the recovery codes generated when you registered your account to reset your registration information. This won't delete your game data.
dialog_account_recovery_body_lost_codes_: <#c5cdd9>If you have lost your recovery codes, please contact the server administrator. They will verify your identity using the email address you provided during registration.
dialog_account_reset_body_info_line:
<#c2fc03>Congatulations!
You have reset your account. You can recreate your account now.
